title: Chile
goal: Explain how the Chilean dictatorship was established and how political institutions changed.

items: Explain how the Chilean dictatorship was established and how political institutions changed.
Use vocabulary for the coup, military government and regime.
Describe how political institutions were restricted after 1973.
Interpret a statement about the later plebiscite.
Use the passive voice to describe historical processes.
